status_definitions.Implemented: Code or configuration exists but this manifest does not assert an execution result.
status_definitions.Locally Verified: Deterministic local or CI evidence passed on bounded fixtures.
status_definitions.Environment-Gated: Code fails closed until deployment-specific controls are supplied and verified.
status_definitions.Live Evidence Required: A production-like or live control must be exercised before go-live.
status_definitions.Deferred/Not Claimed: The capability is intentionally absent or outside the current qualification claim.

hard_go_live_gates.rollback_criteria: Do not promote if required reviews and checks are not enforced.
Disable login and revoke sessions if issuer, key rotation, or tenant binding fails.
Remain unavailable on any count, hash, sequence, key, fence, or rebuild mismatch.
Scale sandbox execution to zero when any admission/runtime/network prerequisite is unverified.
Halt rollout on burn, queue, database, provider, or resource saturation.
No unsigned, unattested, unscanned, mutable, or unmirrored digest may deploy.
